description: Replace the list of routines: small steps that repeat on fixed weekdays. From today on, each one appears as a plan item on its days; tick it with edit_plan_item, skip it for one day with delete_plan_item. set_plan keeps them. days are ISO weekdays 1=Mon..7=Sun, default every day. Pass existing ids to keep them.
name: set_routines
title: Set routines
